evidence.source_content: Washing dishes and utensils: picks up sponge and washes pan, bowl, plastic bag, and knife with sponge and water rinses.

Food preparation: places pot on dish rack, picks up bowl, washes vegetables, arranges scissors and fork on plate, adds cucumber, peas, cut beans to bowls/plates, cuts green beans and green pepper with scissors, puts vegetables in strainer, and cuts vegetables on plate with knife and fork.

Kitchen cleanup and organization: walks around kitchen, puts spoon in bowl, picks up salt, wipes table with cloth, picks up spoon, washes spoon and bowl with sponge, rinses bowl with water, and places bowl on towel.

Handling kitchen items and appliances: picks up and places bowls and lids on counter, picks up pan from cooker, washes pressure cooker lid with sponge, washes plastic container with sponge, washes tray with water, wipes microwave with cloth, and washes cloth with water.

Handling packets and pressure cooker: picks up chopsticks, picks up green packet and walks to sink, cuts packet with scissors, cuts bag with scissors and puts scissors on floor, wipes pressure cooker lid with towel, picks up bowl and puts on rack, and puts lid on bowl.
Final kitchen activities: walks toward sink and opens tap, picks up towel and walks toward sink, and holds and operates phone with both hands.
Outdoor gardening preparation: picks up plastic bag and bowl, walks to door and opens it, picks up plant from ground, digs soil with trowel, and pulls out weeds from soil.

Planting and soil work: digs soil with trowel while holding plant, scoops soil, places plastic bag on soil, pours powder from bowl on soil, places trowel on ground, picks up plastic bag, pours water on plants with watering can, picks up and drops plants on ground, and picks leaves from ground.

Return to indoor activities: picks up bowl and walks around house, washes plate with brush, walks around kitchen, washes bowl with sponge and rinses with water, puts bowl on sink, picks lettuce from bowl, washes vegetables, and walks around house picking up bottle from floor.
